decision_contract.research_question: Among high-confidence Stage-1 flip predictions (frozen Model C, TRAIN P90), can information available at the decision timestamp T distinguish economically clean reversals from ugly, weak, or failed reversals?

model_arms.B: A plus original Stage-1 13 causal features
model_arms.C: B plus final 7 canonical context FeatureInstances

decision_contract.primary_comparison: Does B improve over A, and does C improve over B, on predicting CLEAN_TRADABLE_REVERSAL -- separately for LONG and SHORT, reported by maturity bucket (maturity is a reporting slice, never a model input).
decision_contract.terminal_question: Does contemporaneous signal-time context (current-regime pace, room-to-boundary, participation, order-flow sign, bar shape) add economic-path discrimination beyond frozen Stage-1 flip confidence and its own causal feature surface?
